channel.title: UNICEF Job Vacancies (Filtered)
channel.description: Filtered UNICEF job vacancies: Professional (P-1 to P-5), Director (D-1/D-2), internships and fellowships.

item.title: Supply Chain Specialist (Systems Strengthening), P-3, Fixed Term Position, Kabul, Afghanistan, #00138044
item.description: The ability of the Supply Chain Specialist to successfully plan, manage and oversee the effective and efficient supply chain management of goods, services and construction works for UNICEF programmes, and provide ongoing support to localization and end-user initiatives, directly impact on program goals and results for children. The impact of work directly affects the overall reputation of UNICEF with the authorities and the health donors. This in turn contributes to maintaining/enhancing the credibility of UNICEF as an effective and responsible manager of funds entrusted to the organization and to furthering UNICEF image as a competent organization for delivering cost effective and sustainable program results for children.

item.title: Technical Officer, P-2, Temporary Position, 364 days, Supply Division, Copenhagen, Denmark #00138905
item.description: Support cold chain and immunization supply chain initiatives through technical knowledge management, product quality improvement, infrastructure and energy solutions, and coordination of technical support to Country Offices.

item.title: Digital Impact Officer (Technology for Development), P-2, FT, #00018757, Digital Impact Division, Digital Empowerment – DCOE, Nairobi, Kenya.
item.description: This position supports UNICEF's digital transformation agenda by strengthening country-level access to digital, data, and AI solutions through the TeamOne collaboration model. The incumbent will help coordinate and facilitate cross-country support, contribute to the implementation and quality assurance of digital solutions using the UNICEF Digital Playbook, and ensure alignment with digital standards, cybersecurity, data protection, interoperability, and governance requirements. The role also supports the identification and triaging of country office digital, data, and AI needs, leveraging data and insights to improve support mechanisms and community engagement. In addition, the incumbent will contribute to knowledge management, learning, and capacity-building initiatives, foster knowledge sharing across UNICEF's digital community, and help strengthen digital capabilities across country offices through collaboration, learning events, and community management activities. This position is ideal for candidates with an interest in digital development, knowledge management, AI and data-driven innovation, stakeholder coordination, and digital capacity building in an international development context.

item.title: Health Specialist - Adolescent Health, P-4, Fixed Term Position, #00133499, Global Programme Division, Health-MNCAH, Nairobi - Kenya COE.
item.description: Join UNICEF's Global Programme Division as a Health Specialist (Adolescent Health) and play a pivotal role in advancing adolescent health and well-being worldwide. Based in Nairobi within UNICEF's Centre of Excellence, you will provide strategic leadership and technical expertise to strengthen adolescent-responsive health systems and services, influence global policy and guidance, and support countries in designing and scaling evidence-based programmes. Working closely with governments, development partners, UNICEF Regional and Country Offices, you will drive innovation, capacity development, knowledge generation, partnerships, and resource mobilization to improve equitable access to quality health services for adolescents and contribute to sustainable results at global, regional and country levels.

item.title: Chief Field Office (P-4), FT, #82112, Hyderabad, India - APRO
item.description: UNICEF India is seeking a dynamic and strategic leader to serve as Chief Field Office, Hyderabad, India overseeing UNICEF’s engagement across the states of Andhra Pradesh, Telangana and Karnataka. Reporting to the Chief Field Services, the incumbent will provide overall leadership and management of the field office, driving programme excellence, policy advocacy, systems strengthening and partnerships to advance children's rights and development outcomes.

item.title: Programme Specialist, P-3, Temporary Position, Majuro, Republic of Marshall Islands, #00138682, 364 days
item.description: Join UNICEF as a Programme Specialist, P-3 in Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI), and play a pivotal role in advancing children’s rights and development across the North Pacific. This exciting position offers the opportunity to lead and manage high-impact programmes, working closely with government counterparts, development partners, communities, and civil society organizations to deliver sustainable and result-driven solutions for children and families. Ideal for a dynamic professional with strong programme management, partnership-building, and policy engagement experience, the role provides a unique platform to influence development priorities, strengthen national capacities, and support evidence-based programming. As part of UNICEF’s Pacific Multi-Country Office, you will contribute to programme planning, implementation, monitoring, and advocacy efforts while gaining valuable experience in a culturally rich and diverse island context.

item.title: Public Partnership Specialist (P-3), FT, #00117051, Regional Services Div, Prog Section, Panama City – Panama, LACR
item.description: UNICEF is seeking a Partnerships Specialist (P-3) to support the development and strengthening of strategic partnerships and resource mobilization efforts. The role will identify and pursue opportunities for engagement and collaboration with key partners and stakeholders, contribute to partnership and resource mobilization strategies, monitor the external environment for opportunities and risks, and provide strategic support for high-level engagement. The position will also contribute to policy influence, outreach and communications efforts aimed at enhancing UNICEF’s visibility and advancing its mission for children.

item.title: Deputy Representative Operations, (P-5) Fixed Term #86195, Niamey, Niger, WCAR
item.description: An exciting and rewarding opportunity has arisen at the UNICEF Niger Country Office for a highly motivated and committed professional to serve as Deputy Representative, Operations at the P-5 level. The Deputy Representative Operations serve as a core member of the senior management team, acting as a strategic partner to the Representative and Deputy Representative Programme in ensuring the effective, efficient, and compliant management of country office. The role also strengthens internal controls, promotes a culture of accountability and service excellence, and enables evidence-based decision-making, thereby supporting the Representative in achieving organizational objectives and maximizing impact at country level. Further, the role provides leadership and oversight of the operations function – covering administration budget, finance, Digital Impact, supply chain, and risk management while aligning Operations management with Programme delivery focusing on programmatic priorities. By leading multiple cross-functional teams, the Deputy Representative Operations drives integrated planning, resource optimization, risk management and performance monitoring, ensuring that systems, processes and people are positioned to deliver results.

item.title: Programme Specialist (Financing for Scale), P-4, Fixed Term Position, #00133668, Global Programme Division, Nutrition and Child Development, Brussels, Belgium
item.description: Join UNICEF’s Global Programme Division and help advance financing solutions that improve nutrition outcomes for children, adolescents, and women. As Programme Specialist (Financing for Scale), you will provide strategic leadership and technical expertise to strengthen nutrition financing through the Child Nutrition Fund (CNF), supporting governments and UNICEF Country Offices to identify, develop, and implement financing opportunities that increase investment in nutrition. You will build partnerships with multilateral development banks, international financial institutions, and other development finance actors, while advancing innovative and catalytic financing approaches. The role also leads evidence generation, knowledge development, advocacy, and thought leadership efforts to elevate nutrition financing on global, regional, and national agendas. Through these efforts, you will help mobilize resources, strengthen country-led investments, and expand the reach and impact of the CNF in support of improved outcomes for children.

item.title: Social Policy Specialist (Child Responsive Budgeting), P-4, Fixed Term Position, #00134590, Global Programme Division, Economic & Social Policy, COE Amman, Jordan
item.description: Join UNICEF’s Public Finance for Children (PF4C) Unit within the Child Poverty Centre of Excellence in Amman and help advance equitable and sustainable financing for children worldwide. As a Social Policy Specialist, you will provide technical support to UNICEF offices and partners on child-responsive budgeting, public financial management, fiscal policy, social sector financing, and evidence-based policy reforms. Working with governments, development partners, international financial institutions, and UNICEF country and regional teams, you will contribute to strengthening public systems, building capacity, generating knowledge, and scaling innovative approaches that improve outcomes for children. This is an exciting opportunity to influence policies and investments that help reduce child poverty and accelerate progress towards the Sustainable Development Goals.

item.title: Child Protection Specialist (Armed Violence), (P-3), TA, #00138861, 6 months, Mexico City – Mexico, LACR
item.description: Are you an experienced child protection professional with expertise in armed violence, child recruitment prevention and reintegration? Join UNICEF Mexico to help shape and implement strategic, evidence-based responses for children affected by armed and criminal violence, working with government, civil society, communities and other partners to strengthen prevention, protection and reintegration systems.

item.title: Internship, Estagiário de Comunicação UNICEF Salvador, BA, Brasil.
item.description: Esta seleção tem como objetivo buscar um/a estagiário/a para que possa enriquecer sua experiência educacional por meio de atividades práticas. O/a estagiário/a irá contribuir com o trabalho de comunicação realizado em Salvador e na região do Semiárido Brasileiro (SAB). Sob orientação e supervisão do Especialista de Comunicação do Escritório do UNICEF em Salvador/BA, irá produzir conteúdo, monitorar a mídia, organizar informações/dados e contatos com parceiros, dar suporte ao desenvolvimento de conteúdo para a plataforma digital do SELO UNICEF, apoiar a realização de reuniões e eventos, interagindo com a equipe do UNICEF, bem como com parceiros do governo, da sociedade civil e outros profissionais/empresas de comunicação.

item.title: Health & Nutrition Specialist (P-3), TA, 364 days, #138749, Algiers - Algeria, MENA
item.description: The Health & Nutrition specialist will provide international technical leadership and surge capacity for programme planning, implementation, monitoring and partnership coordination. The incumbent will support both national-level engagement and field implementation, including in humanitarian settings, while strengthening the sustainability, quality and evidence base of UNICEF-supported interventions.

item.title: Nutrition Specialist (P-3), FT, #00118343, Antananarivo, Madagascar, ESAR
item.description: UNICEF Madagascar is seeking an experienced Nutrition Specialist to lead the First Food initiative and advance sustainable food systems that improve child nutrition. The position will drive partnerships, innovation and evidence-based programming to increase access to nutritious foods for young children, strengthen dietary diversity, and support the achievement of national nutrition and sustainable development goals. Join a dynamic team committed to delivering lasting results for children and families across Madagascar.

item.title: Partnerships Specialist, P-3, Temporary Position, 364 days, Private Fund Raising and Partnerships, Outposted to New York, United States, #00138638
item.description: Under the guidance of the Deputy Director, PSFP and working closely with the Fundraising Business Manager, the Partnerships Specialist provides strategic and operational support to advance UNICEF’s private sector fundraising and partnership priorities. The role supports the stewardship and growth of high-value partnerships, strengthens collaboration across National Committees, Country Offices and global teams, and helps drive key initiatives that improve ways of working, deepen partner engagement and maximise results for children.

item.title: Chief Emergency, P-5, FT, #138655, Caracas-Venezuela, LACR
item.description: The Venezuela Country Office operates in a complex and evolving humanitarian and development context in which children and families may be affected by multiple and overlapping risks, including natural hazards, public health emergencies, climate-related events, population movements and disruptions to essential social services. The major earthquake of June 2026 has added a significant humanitarian and recovery dimension, requiring UNICEF to sustain immediate humanitarian assistance while supporting the restoration and strengthening of essential services and national and local systems. At the same time, the Country Office must maintain readiness to respond to new or concurrent emergencies throughout the country.UNICEF Venezuela will therefore require a strong and integrated approach linking emergency preparedness, humanitarian response, early recovery and recovery, disaster risk reduction, anticipatory action and resilience.

item.title: Deputy Representative Operations, P-4, #135737, TA (3 months), Nouakchott - Mauritania, WCAR
item.description: The Strategic Business Partner and Deputy Head of Office provides strategic leadership, drives change, and delivers risk-informed analysis and solutions to support effective programme and management decisions, ensuring results for children in all operational contexts.

item.title: Internship: UPSHIFT Scale Intern, GPD/Office of Innovation - Stockholm, Sweden - 6 months (full time) - Remote
item.description: Join UNICEF’s Office of Innovation and support the digital and AI-enabled scale-up of UPSHIFT. This six-month internship will contribute to tracking and coordinating digital and AI initiatives and maintaining UPSHIFT’s portfolio of digital platforms, tools, content and technology assets.

item.title: Internship - Social & Behavior Change, 26 weeks, Colombo Sri Lanka (Sri Lankan nationals only)
item.description: The overall purpose of this internship is to support the S&BC officer in carrying out the Social and Behavior Change, Community Engagement, Accountability to Affected People (AAP) interventions across key thematic areas.

item.title: INTERNAL EXTERNAL ADV: Deputy Representative Operations (P5), Temporary Appointment (6 months), #138658, Jakarta, Indonesia
item.description: UNICEF Indonesia is looking for Deputy Representative Operations under Temporary Appointment contract at P5 level for 6 months. The incumbent will be responsible to lead for results, drive change, provide risk informed, solution-focused analysis, advice and services and contribute to programme and management decisions for delivering results for children in all operational contexts. Specifically, the Deputy Representative Operations will focus on the following critical tasks during the 6-month contract duration: - Year-end closure - Preparation for audit - Reviewing the team compositions and workload - Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) - Business Continuity Plan (BCP) - Business Operations Strategy (BOS)

item.title: Chief Education (P-4), Fixed Term Position, 24 months, #5192, Luanda - Angola
item.description: UNICEF Angola is seeking a Chief of Education (P-4) to provide strategic leadership to its Education Programme, advancing foundational learning, quality teaching, inclusive education, system strengthening, digital learning and skills development. The role will lead programme strategy, partnerships and advocacy to improve equitable learning outcomes for children and adolescents across Angola.

item.title: Monitoring, Learning and Reporting / Monitoring and Evaluation Officer, P-2, Temporary Position, 364 days, #00138813, Bangui, Central African Republic - WCAR
item.description: UNICEF works in some of the world’s toughest places, to reach the world’s most disadvantaged children. To save their lives. To defend their rights. To help them fulfill their potential.Across 190 countries and territories, we work for every child, everywhere, every day, to build a better world for everyone. And we never give up.

item.title: Digital Communication Specialist (Web Editor), P-3, Fixed Term Position, Rome, Italy, #00112315
item.description: Education requirement: Advanced university degree (Master's or higher) in Communication, Journalism, International Relations, Development Studies, or related fields. Two years of additional relevant work experience that was gained after obtaining a bachelor’s degree may be accepted in lieu of advanced degree. Experience required:A minimum of five years of relevant, progressively responsible, professional work experience in digital communications, external relations, writing and editing (or equivalent fields), of which at least two years involve managing website content and digital communication channels, is required.Language requirements: Fluency in English is required. Working knowledge of another official UN language (Arabic, Chinese, French, Russian or Spanish) or a local language is an asset.

item.title: Chief Risk Management (P-5), FT, #00118980, Kabul, Afghanistan - APRO
item.description: The Chief Risk Management position at P5 level (risk management and quality assurance) supports the country office on monitoring, mitigating and managing risks and provides objective assurance and advisory to the country office senior management team designed to add value and improve the operations of UNICEF.

item.title: Child Protection Specialist, (P-3), FT, #137773, Gaza, State of Palestine, MENA
item.description: The fundamental mission of UNICEF is to promote the rights of every child, everywhere, in everything the organization does — in programmes, in advocacy and in operations. The equity strategy, emphasizing the most disadvantaged and excluded children and families, translates this commitment to children’s rights into action. For UNICEF, equity means that all children have an opportunity to survive, develop and reach their full potential, without discrimination, bias or favoritism. To the degree that any child has an unequal chance in life — in its social, political, economic, civic and cultural dimensions — her or his rights are violated.

item.title: Innovation Specialist, P-3, Temporary Position, GPD/Office of Innovation, 364 days, Solutions, OOI, #00135967
item.description: This position is based in Stockholm, Sweden. The incumbent is expected to work from the Office of Innovation premises at least three days per week. The role requires flexibility to participate in meetings, events and partner engagements in Stockholm and the wider Nordic region, including on short notice. Remote work may be authorized under UNICEF's flexible work arrangement policy.

item.title: Chief of Operations, P-4, FT, 24 months, #00134070, Global Communication &Advocacy, Rome, Italy
item.description: Join UNICEF as a Chief of Operations (P-4) and play a pivotal role in driving operational excellence for the Division of Global Communication and Advocacy (DGCA). As a strategic business partner to senior leadership, you will lead key functions including financial and budget management, human resources, administration, procurement, ICT, risk management, governance, and business continuity across multiple international locations.

item.title: International EMIS Development Specialist, 1 month, 21 days, remote, Kosovo
item.description: UNICEF is seeking an International EMIS and ToR Development Specialist to lead the technical preparation of a comprehensive, procurement-ready Terms of Reference (ToR) for Kosovo’s new Education Management Information System (EMIS), working closely with a National EMIS Specialist.

item.title: Consultoría Nacional Ruta de Referenciación de Casos de NNA separados o no acompañados, 3 meses, Protección de la infancia, Caracas (Remote, national)
item.description: Diseñar y validar una ruta para la identificación, referenciación, atención, reunificación familiar (cuando corresponda) y seguimiento de casos de niños, niñas y adolescentes separados o no acompañados debido al impacto del doblete sísmico, a fin de fortalecer los mecanismos de protección de la niñez y garantizar una respuesta oportuna, coordinada, segura y centrada en el interés superior del niño, de conformidad con la legislación nacional y los estándares internacionales de protección de la niñez y la adolescencia.

item.title: Communication and Advocacy Specialist, P-3, TA (6 months), #138683, Ouagadougou - Burkina-Faso, WCAR
item.description: UNICEF Burkina Faso's 2027—2030 programme aces strong emphasis on integrated programming, resilience of essential services, evidence generation for policy dialogue and Number/level of posts supervised: 2 advocacy, social and behaviour change, social protection, partnership development and resource leveraging. The Communication and Advocacy Specialist will help translate programme evidence and field realities into compelling advocacy, visibility and engagement products for government, donors, communities, media, young people and the wider public.

item.title: Planning Specialist (Budget & Finance), (P3), #98208, GPD/Office of Innovation/Directors Office, - Stockholm, Sweden
item.description: Join UNICEF’s Office of Innovation in Stockholm as a Planning Specialist (Budget & Finance), P-3. This role brings together planning, budgeting, grant management and financial analysis to strengthen resource management and support informed decision-making across a dynamic, multi-team environment.

item.title: Statistics & Monitoring Officer (P2), Temporary Position (364 days), #138654, OSE - Florence, Italy
item.description: The key results of the incumbent will have an impact on UNICEF's capacity to monitor and improve results for children and adolescents around the world by increasing quality and availability of evidence on mortality and demographics indicators including UNICEF’s Strategic Plan, SDGs (3.2.1 and 3.2.2) and other survival targets. The results of the duties and tasks of this position will contribute to evidence generation, global monitoring and advocacy efforts to improve child survival.

item.title: Procurement Services Manager, P-4, Fixed Term Position, Supply Division, Copenhagen, Denmark, #00021902
item.description: Under the general guidance of the Chief, Supply Financing, responsible to ensure a proactive and systematic approach of identifying and executing business transactions in close collaboration with Country Offices in the procurement of goods and services on behalf of partners.

item.title: Deputy Representative Operations (P-4) Temporary Appointment/TA, 6 months, position #138620, Bissau, Guinea-Bissau, WCAR
item.description: An exciting and challenging opportunity is now available within the UNICEF Guinea-Bissau Country Office for a highly motivated and dedicated Deputy Representative, Operations (P-4). The Operations function is a strategic Business Partner role within the Senior Management Team, assuring the best use of UNICEF assets in alignment with sound management practices, office priorities and goals to deliver results for children. The function supports the Head of the Office on managing the office and monitoring operations and programmes as needed while providing advice on best and innovative management practices to enhance office performance.
